title: Dig Dug
shortDescription: Dig Dug helps define a Game Boy family action path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Frames a action catalog entry for source-aware Game Boy family exploration.
Separates the GameAtlas catalog method from the external factual reference.
